tools.description: Create the new hire's Okta user.
Create the new hire's Google Workspace account.
Invite the new hire to Fernhill's Slack.
Order the new hire's laptop from CDW.
Order company polos for the new hire.
Order the new hire's business cards.
Create the new hire's payroll record in ADP.
Issue the new hire a company card on Mercury.

policies.rationale: This is the company's decision: routine account setup for a new hire, one user in Fernhill's own directory that can be deactivated, so no sign-off is needed.
policies.name: Create the new hire in Okta — runs freely
policies.description: Fernhill lets the onboarding agent create Okta accounts without asking.

policies.rationale: This is the company's decision: routine account setup for a new hire, one account in Fernhill's own workspace that can be suspended, so no sign-off is needed.
policies.name: Create the Google Workspace account — runs freely
policies.description: Fernhill lets the onboarding agent create Google accounts without asking.

policies.rationale: This is the company's decision: routine setup for a new hire, one invitation to Fernhill's own workspace that can be revoked, so no sign-off is needed.
policies.name: Invite to Slack — runs freely
policies.description: Fernhill lets the onboarding agent send Slack invitations without asking.

policies.rationale: This is the company's decision: Fernhill has decided a standard laptop order for a new hire does not need sign-off, even though it spends money with an outside vendor.
policies.name: Order the laptop from CDW — runs freely
policies.description: A vendor order, but Fernhill has decided routine laptop orders need no approval.

policies.rationale: This is the company's decision: Fernhill has decided company polos for a new hire do not need sign-off, even though it spends money with an outside vendor.
policies.name: Order welcome polos — runs freely
policies.description: A vendor order, but Fernhill has decided routine merchandise orders need no approval.

policies.rationale: This is the company's decision: Fernhill has decided business cards for a new hire do not need sign-off, even though it spends money with an outside vendor.
policies.name: Order business cards — runs freely
policies.description: A vendor order, but Fernhill has decided routine print orders need no approval.

policies.rationale: Creates a payroll record with a salary at an outside payroll provider: it commits money and is hard to undo cleanly, so a person checks every one.
policies.name: Add the employee to ADP payroll — a person approves
policies.description: Creates a payroll record; a person approves each one.

policies.rationale: Issues a company card with a spending limit: it commits money and spend cannot be recalled, so Finance checks every new card.
policies.name: Issue a Mercury company card — a person approves
policies.description: Issues a card that spends company money; a person approves each one.

policies.rationale: Grants administrator rights across the whole directory. This agent must never do it, whatever the arguments.
policies.name: Grant Okta admin rights — never
policies.description: The agent must never give anyone Okta administrator rights.
